decision.thesis: No entry. The account is flat, so there is nothing to manage and the only question is whether to open. The 23:00 note named one fact to settle at 00:00 - whether XRPUSDT is still above 1.4969 - and set a three-part confirmation test for the long in advance so that this check would not have to re-derive it. The test resolves cleanly, and it fails on all three parts. (1) HOLD FAILS. XRP did not hold. After the 15:05Z bar printed the new 24h high of 1.5077 and closed 1.5049, price fell to 1.4849 by 15:25Z - 1.51% off the high and decisively below 1.4969 - and closed the 15:20Z through 15:40Z bars entirely beneath it. It reclaimed 1.5001 at 15:45Z and 1.5011 at 15:50Z, failed again, and at the decision-time re-quote of 16:14:23Z the book is 1.4953/1.4954, BELOW 1.4969. The condition was a hold 45+ minutes after the break rather than eight; what happened instead was a third rejection. (2) VOLUME FAILS. The test was the 15Z or 16Z hour exceeding the 13Z hour's participation. The 13Z hour traded 6,080,932,514 and the 14Z 6,047,285,710; the 15Z hour that made the high traded 5,446,947,705 - contraction on both comparisons. The new high came on less trade than the two hours before it. (3) HEAVIEST BAR FAILS. The test was that the heaviest 5m bar of the stretch be an up bar. It is 15:15Z at 905,600,567, and it is the DOWN bar that erased the breakout: open 1.5016, close 1.4958. The heaviest up bar in the window is 15:30Z at 634,823,054, 30% smaller. The long is therefore declined on the criteria set in advance, with no re-derivation. What makes this hour instructive is the other half. Because price has now fallen 0.41% from the 1.5015 ask that was rejected at 23:00, the long's arithmetic PASSES at the decision-time quote - 2.343 net with a 1.4849 stop, 3.107 with a 1.4880 stop, against a 1.50 floor. Nothing improved; the evidence got worse on all three named counts and the ratio got better purely because the entry fell toward a fixed stop. That is precisely the drift trap the 22:00 and 23:00 notes named in advance, and it is now demonstrated at a larger amplitude. Worse, both passing constructions are invalid on their own terms: the market traded 1.4849 at 15:25Z and 1.4863 at 15:30Z and 15:35Z, so a 1.4880 stop has already been traded through three times in the last 50 minutes and a 1.4849 stop sits exactly on a low printed 50 minutes ago. Neither is a stop; both are sizes. The pre-named short trigger DID fire - price is back below 1.4969, so the 15:05Z break joins the 14:05Z one as a failed breakout - and the 23:00 note called that the first real short candidate, requiring a second category. It was worked through properly and it fails on arithmetic, not on judgement. The stop that the thesis demands is above the 1.5077 session high that defines the failed breakout, so 1.5085, a 0.90% risk. Against that stop the nearest honest target, the 1.4849 low the last rejection actually produced, prints 0.543 net. The next level down, 1.4765, the low of the 14Z hour that the first failed breakout bottomed at, prints 1.093. Even 1.4710, two levels deep, prints only 1.452 - still under the floor. The only construction that clears is a 1.5020 stop with a 1.4765 target at 1.900, and 1.5020 sits BELOW the 1.5077 high that is the entire reason for the trade: the very print that defines the setup would take the stop out. That is a stop fitted to a size, which the strategy prohibits, and it is the same error the 23:00 note refused on the long side. So both directions now produce a passing ratio on some construction while neither produces one on an honest stop, which is the clearest evidence yet that XRP's ratios this session are being manufactured by geometry rather than earned by edge. On evidence the short reaches two categories on paper - price_action in three rejections of the 1.50 zone inside 80 minutes, and market_context in a complex that gave back ground on every one of the five contracts this hour - but the volume reading that looks like a third is not independent: the heavy down bars ARE the rejection candles, so describing them twice is one observation, exactly the ruling the 23:00 note made when it counted trend and market_context as one. And the higher-timeframe trend argues plainly against: XRP is +7.71% on the day with rising hourly lows from 1.4143 through 1.4849, the last four 5m bars are a flat coil between 1.4942 and 1.4986 with no downside momentum, and a short at 1.4953 enters the middle of the 1.4849-1.5077 range, the worst location available. Reaching past 1.4849 to 1.4765 to make the number work is the same target-chosen-to-satisfy-arithmetic move that the 22:00 and 23:00 notes both rejected. The other four contracts fail as well, three of them on the identical upside-down geometry. SOLUSDT is the one that newly acquired an overhead reference - it pulled back off today's 118.9100 high, so a target exists for the first time - but at an ask of 117.61 that target is only 1.10% away while SOL's own 15Z hourly bar spanned 117.36 to 118.91, a range of 1.32%: the target again sits inside one hour of the contract's range. It passes at 2.391 only with a 117.30 stop, a 0.28% stop in a contract whose 15:15Z and 16:00Z 5m bars alone spanned 0.71% and 0.57%; honest stops below the 117.36 shelf print 1.465 and 1.066. Volume opposes it too - the two heaviest 5m bars of the 15Z-16Z stretch, 7,985,396 at 15:15Z and 7,839,238 at 15:20Z, are the down bars that rejected 118.91. BNBUSDT likewise regained a reference at 806.090 but it is 0.61% overhead against a 15Z hourly range of 1.06%, passing at 1.310 only on a 0.24% stop when price traded 800.170 five minutes ago, and 0.798 on an honest one. ETHUSDT needed 2720.39 or lower and instead sits at 2746.91 for 0.350 net on the unchanged 2693.00/2771.00 structure - a sixth consecutive failure after 1.34, 0.55, 1.40, 0.45 and 0.38 - and it printed the first non-BTC artifact of the experiment this hour, a 2795.00 high at 15:50Z on a bar with a 0.04% body. BTCUSDT remains structurally untradeable: a seventh artifact printed at 15:05Z (86999.00, a 0.92% upper wick with no counterpart), its reported 24h high of 95804.10 is itself an artifact, and excluding them leaves no overhead reference anywhere in sixty days, which is the condition under which the strategy requires no_trade for a contract whose structure artifacts have made unreadable.

evidence.observed: THE PRE-NAMED HOLD TEST FAILED, AND THE FAILURE IS NOW A THIRD REJECTION. The 23:00 note required price to still be above 1.4969 at this check, a full 45+ minutes after the 15:05Z break rather than the eight minutes it had then. It is not, and it did not hold at any point in between. Sequence from the 15:05Z high of 1.5077: 15:10Z closed 1.5014, 15:15Z opened 1.5016 and closed 1.4958 (through the level), 15:20Z closed 1.4942, 15:25Z printed the low of 1.4849 - 1.51% below the high - and 15:30Z and 15:35Z both bottomed at 1.4863. Five consecutive 5m bars closed beneath 1.4969. Price then rebuilt to a 1.5001 high at 15:45Z and 1.5011 at 15:50Z and was rejected again, closing 15:55Z at 1.4949. The last four bars are a flat coil, 1.4942 to 1.4986, and the decision-time book at 16:14:23Z is 1.4953/1.4954 - below the level. Counting the whole session that is three rejections of the 1.5000-1.5077 zone inside roughly 80 minutes (14:55Z high 1.5039, 15:05Z high 1.5077, 15:50Z high 1.5011), on top of the completed 14:05Z failed breakout. This is the bearish item the 23:00 note said would appear if 1.4969 was lost, and it is recorded as real. It is also, on its own, one category against a requirement of two.

BOTH PRE-NAMED VOLUME TESTS FAILED, WHICH IS WHAT DISQUALIFIES THE LONG. Test one was that the 15Z or 16Z hour exceed the 13Z hour. The 13Z hour traded 6,080,932,514 and the 14Z hour 6,047,285,710; the 15Z hour - the one containing the new 24h high - traded 5,446,947,705, a contraction against both. The 16Z hour is ten minutes old at 1,372,500,674 and cannot confirm anything. Test two was that the heaviest 5m bar of that stretch be an up bar. It is 15:15Z at 905,600,567, and it is the DOWN bar that erased the breakout: open 1.5016, high 1.5017, low 1.4957, close 1.4958. The heaviest up bar of the stretch is 15:30Z at 634,823,054, 30% smaller, and the previous hour's heaviest bar was also a down bar (14:55Z, 1,007,494,915, rejecting from 1.5039 to close 1.4963). Participation has been on the sell side through the entire episode. NOTE ON INDEPENDENCE, recorded deliberately: this reading is NOT counted as a second category supporting a short, because the heavy down bars ARE the rejection candles described in the price_action item. Counting them twice would be the same error the 23:00 note refused when it ruled trend and market_context one observation rather than two. It is decisive against the long and it is not additive to the short.

Every contract is below its 23:00 reading: SOLUSDT +8.239% (was +9.742%), XRPUSDT +7.710% (8.516%), BTCUSDT +5.922% (6.755%), BNBUSDT +5.450% (6.036%), ETHUSDT +5.117% (5.631%). This is genuinely independent of XRP's own candles and it is the second category a short would need. It is recorded as supportive-but-weak rather than sufficient, for two reasons. First, the higher-timeframe trend flatly contradicts it: XRP is still up 7.71% on the day with rising hourly lows - 1.4143, 1.4258, 1.4311, 1.4383, 1.4710, 1.4717, 1.4847, 1.4847, 1.4790, 1.4765, 1.4849 - and the 15Z low of 1.4849 is the HIGHEST low of the last four hours, which is a flag at the highs, not a topping structure. Second, the give-back is a single hour against twelve hours of advance, and the most recent 5m bars on XRP, BNB and SOL all closed at or near their highs. A one-hour breather is not a reversal.

considered_and_rejected.short_XRPUSDT: The candidate of the hour, triggered by the note written in advance, and rejected on arithmetic rather than judgement. The 23:00 note said that if price fell back below 1.4969 the 15:05Z break would join the 14:05Z one as a second failed breakout in two hours and become the first real short candidate, still needing a second category. Price is below, and the structure is real: three rejections of the 1.5000-1.5077 zone inside 80 minutes. The stop the thesis demands sits above the 1.5077 session high that defines the failed breakout, so 1.5085, a 0.90% risk from the 1.4953 bid. Against it the nearest honest target - 1.4849, the low the most recent rejection actually produced - prints 0.543 net. The next structural level, 1.4765, the low of the 14Z hour where the first failed breakout bottomed, prints 1.093. Even 1.4710, two levels deep and asking for a 1.6% fall, prints 1.452, still beneath the floor. The only clearing construction is a 1.5020 stop with a 1.4765 target at 1.900, and 1.5020 lies BELOW the 1.5077 high which is the entire premise of the trade - the defining print would take the stop out - so it is a stop fitted to a size, prohibited by the strategy and refused by the 23:00 note on the long side for the identical reason. On top of the arithmetic, three qualitative objections were recorded. Evidence: it reaches two categories only by counting market_context, because the heavy-down-bar volume reading is a property of the same rejection candles as the price_action item and is not independent of it. Trend: XRP is +7.71% on the day with the 15Z low of 1.4849 the highest low of the last four hours, so this is a flag at the highs and these consolidations more often resolve upward. Location: at 1.4953 the entry is in the middle of the 1.4849-1.5077 range with no downside momentum - the last four 5m bars are a flat coil between 1.4942 and 1.4986 - which is the worst available place to initiate and is what forces the inverted ratio in the first place.

considered_and_rejected.long_BTCUSDT: Rejected on the artifact rule rather than on price. A seventh artifact printed this hour at 15:05Z - 86999.00, a 0.92% upper wick with no counterpart on any of the other four contracts - joining the 95804.10 pair from 14:35Z and 14:40Z that the 23:00 check identified, and the 87888.00 print in the 12Z hour. With those excluded the 60-day scan finds no valid daily high above the 85703.90 ask anywhere, so no target exists. The strategy directs no_trade for a contract whose structure recent artifacts have made unreadable, and six artifacts on one contract in a single day meets that plainly. Its spread is healthy at 1.86 bps; that is not the issue.

All five remain up 5.1% to 8.2% on the day with intact rising structure, funding is at or below baseline on all five so there is no crowded long to squeeze, and the single bearish observation available - one hour of give-back across the complex - is the market_context item already counted in the XRP case and cannot be re-used as an independent second category elsewhere.

decision.lessons_applied: None available from LESSONS.md: it still records no lessons, because the experiment has no closed trades yet. The file was read, and nothing under reviews/ was modified - the 22:00 daily review owns that folder and may run concurrently. What was applied instead, and treated as binding rather than advisory, is the 23:00 research note's next-task focus, which had set this check up deliberately so it would not repeat prior work. Item 1 named the single fact to settle - whether XRP is still above 1.4969 - and forbade re-running the headline price trigger, which had already fired and failed at 23:00; it supplied a three-part confirmation test (hold 45+ minutes, hourly volume above 4,089,988,720, heaviest 5m bar an up bar). All three were tested and all three failed, and the long was declined on that basis without re-deriving the case. Item 1 also specified what a failure would mean: price back below 1.4969 makes the 15:05Z break a second failed breakout in two hours and the first real short candidate, still requiring a second category. That trigger fired, so the short was worked through in full rather than dismissed - and it failed the reward/risk floor on every stop above the 1.5077 high, which is the honest outcome to record. Item 2 predicted the mechanism that dominated this hour: any 1.5 net reading on XRP would be manufactured by a tight stop or by drift rather than by an edge, and a confirming hold that also rallied would make the long worse rather than better. The inverse happened - price fell instead - and the prediction held exactly: the long's ratio improved from 1.499 to 3.107 on nothing but a 0.41% fall onto stops the market has since traded through. Item 3 said not to re-examine ETHUSDT unless it had fallen to 2720.39; it had not, so it was checked once against that threshold and set aside at 0.350. Item 4 required the 60-day overhead scan to be re-verified from daily bars rather than carried forward, and warned that another hour of movement could create references - which is exactly what happened, since BNBUSDT and SOLUSDT both pulled back off today's highs and acquired overhead levels for the first time, changing their status from no-target to failed-geometry and requiring both to be worked through properly. The 23:00 note's ruling on evidence independence was also carried forward and applied to the short: heavy down bars that are the same candles as the rejections are one observation, not two.
